title: Pani pivravjo
body:
Ya Hussain (a.s) Ya Hussain (a.s)...
Ya Hussain (a.s) Ya Hussain (a.s)...
Ya Hussain (a.s)....
Hussain Ya Hussain, Hussain Ya Hussain
Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
Naam e mola Hussain Paani pivravjo.....
- Su che karbobala sav ne samjavjo.....
Naam e mola Hussain.......
1) Satrusena ne pan jene paani didhu
Tena mastaq ne zalim e kaapi lidhu....(2)
Dukh bhari daasta, sav ne sambhdavjo
Naam e mola Hussain.......
2) Satyata, maan(r)saayi bachaavi gaya
Su che haq mara mola batavi gaya....(2)
Maqsad e Karbala, Dil thi samjavjo
Naam e mola Hussain.......
3) Baarko, Dosto, Bhai-Behno ne gaa'rn
Ristedaaro ni saathe Padosi ne pa'rn....(2)
Majlis e saah maa, saathe lai aavjo
Naam e mola Hussain.......
4) Bukhne pyaas thi jene tadpaviya
Bund pani ne maate pan tarsaviya....(2)
Nazr e mola Hussain, Sav ne khavravjo
Naam e mola Hussain.......
5) Koye ni maut ni sambhdo jo khabar
Rard'jo karbobala na musafir upar....(2)
Yaad seh ne kari, Teney Dafnavjo
Naam e mola Hussain.......
6) Aa Azadari che ek maa ni Dua
Karjo Akbar sada teni saathe wafa...(2)
Nasl ma aa Raza sav ne Sikdavjo
Naam e mola Hussain.......
Hussain Ya Hussain, Hussain Ya Hussain
Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain Ya Hussain
